description: Damien Bay is a stunning and secluded coastal gem nestled along Trinidad’s lush North Coast, just past Maracas Bay. This beach is famous for its calm shaded liming spots and small river, it is a favorite quiet retreat for surfers, nature lovers, and eco-tourists. Listed opening hours: 24 HOURS. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
